description: This file implements a Nostr bus for encrypted messaging, including relay management, message handling, encryption/decryption, relay health tracking, circuit breaker logic, and pubkey utilities.

classes.name: FixedWindowRateLimiter
classes.description: Implements rate limiting using fixed window counters.

classes.name: CircuitBreaker
classes.description: Manages circuit breaker state for relay request failures.

classes.name: RelayHealthTracker
classes.description: Tracks relay health metrics and scores relays based on success, failure, latency, and recency.

methods.name: createFixedWindowRateLimiter
methods.description: Creates a rate limiter with fixed window counters.

methods.name: createCircuitBreaker
methods.description: Creates a circuit breaker for relay request management.

methods.name: createRelayHealthTracker
methods.description: Creates a relay health tracker instance.

methods.name: validatePrivateKey
methods.description: Validates and decodes a private key in hex or bech32 format.

methods.name: getPublicKeyFromPrivate
methods.description: Derives a public key from a private key.

methods.name: startNostrBus
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Nostr encrypted messaging bus, managing relay subscriptions, message handling, and state persistence.

methods.name: sendEncryptedDm
methods.description: Sends an encrypted direct message via relays, respecting circuit breakers and relay health.

methods.name: isValidPubkey
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid Nostr pubkey (hex or npub).

methods.name: normalizePubkey
methods.description: Converts a pubkey from npub or hex format to normalized hex format.

methods.name: pubkeyToNpub
methods.description: Converts a hex pubkey to npub format.
